title: Present Continuous vs Present Simple
grammarTitle: Present Continuous vs Present Simple — How to Choose
grammarNote: Это одна из самых важных тем на уровне A2. Present Simple описывает ПРИВЫЧКИ, ФАКТЫ и ОБЩИЕ ИСТИНЫ. Present Continuous описывает действия, происходящие ПРЯМО СЕЙЧАС или во ВРЕМЕННОЙ ПЕРИОД. Ключ — это вопрос: "Это постоянное или временное?"

grammarTable.subject: Present Simple
grammarTable.example: She always reviews her notes after class. (habit)

grammarTable.subject: Present Continuous
grammarTable.example: She is reviewing her notes at the moment. (now)

grammarTable.subject: Present Simple
grammarTable.example: The sun rises in the east. (permanent fact)

grammarTable.subject: Present Continuous

grammarTable.subject: Present Continuous
grammarTable.example: He's working from home this week. (temporary)

grammarExtra.title: Signal words — which tense do they trigger?

rows.example: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never, every day/week, on Mondays, generally
right now, at the moment, currently, today, this week/semester, look!, listen!, now
"I study every day." (PS) vs "I'm studying all day today." (PC — specific today)
"I study hard this year." (general) vs "I'm studying harder this year." (changing)
Present Simple = permanent. She has lived there for years.
Present Continuous = temporary. Just for this month.
Present Continuous = temporary, just for today.
Present Continuous: think = process/considering (not stative here!).

rows.form: ✗ "I study in the library right now."
rows.example: ✅ "I'm studying in the library right now." — right now = PC!
✅ "She studies every morning." — every morning = PS habit!

rows.form: ✗ "What does he doing?" / "He doesn't study now."
rows.example: ✅ "What is he doing?" / "He isn't studying now." — use be, not do/does, for PC.
✅ "I know the answer." — stative: never in Continuous.

grammarExtra.title: Asking questions: right now vs in general

rows.example: "I'm a student." / "I study Computer Science." — about your life.
"I'm fixing a bug." / "I'm waiting for Kamila." — current action.
"I'm staying with my aunt this month." — not permanent.

grammarTip:
Простой тест для выбора времени:
① Спроси: "Это постоянное или временное?" → Постоянное = Present Simple. Временное = Present Continuous.
② Спроси: "Это прямо сейчас или всегда?" → Прямо сейчас = Present Continuous. Всегда = Present Simple.
③ Найди сигнальные слова: always/never/every day → PS. Right now/at the moment/currently → PC.
④ Если глагол stative (know/like/want/have/understand) — ВСЕГДА Present Simple!

💡 Запомни: 'right now' → Present Continuous. 'every day' → Present Simple. Это 90% случаев.

exercises.text: Amir ___ in the library every Tuesday, but today he ___ in the lab.
exercises.hint: every Tuesday = PS (habit). today he is doing something different = PC (temporary/now).
"Listen!" and "Shhh!" are signals for right now → Present Continuous.

exercises.text: Kamila ___ (usually / work) until 9 p.m., but tonight she ___ (finish) early.
exercises.hint: usually = PS habit. tonight = temporary/different from normal = PC.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct tense for this question.
exercises.text: "___ you do in your free time?" (in general)
exercises.hint: "In general" = about your life and habits → Present Simple. "What do you do in your free time?"

exercises.text: "She is studying every evening" is correct because she studies a lot.
exercises.hint: "every evening" = frequency adverb = Present Simple. ✅ "She studies every evening." NOT "is studying every evening".

exercises.text: Technology ___ very fast these days — it's amazing.
exercises.hint: "these days" + ongoing change = Present Continuous. Technology is changing right now (developing trend).

exercises.text: He ___ (live) in Aktobe, but this semester he ___ (stay) in the WKU dormitory.
exercises.hint: "lives in Aktobe" = permanent fact = PS. "staying in the dormitory" = temporary this semester = PC.

exercises.instruction: Which question asks about a CURRENT action (right now)?
exercises.text: Choose the correct question for "right now".
opts: What do you usually do at weekends?
What are you doing at the moment?
What do you do for a living?
How often do you go to the library?
exercises.correct: What are you doing at the moment?
exercises.hint: "At the moment" → right now → Present Continuous question: "What are you doing?" ✅

questions.text: Choose the correct tense: "She ___ in the library every Thursday."
questions.hint: "every Thursday" = frequency adverb → Present Simple habit.

questions.text: Choose the correct tense: "Look! She ___ a first-year student."
questions.hint: "Look!" = signal for right now → Present Continuous.

questions.text: "I ___ (live) in Uralsk, but this month I ___ (stay) in Astana."
questions.hint: live = permanent (PS). staying this month = temporary (PC).

questions.text: "Right now" is a signal word for Present Simple.
questions.hint: "right now" → action happening at this moment → Present Continuous. "every day" → Present Simple.

questions.text: "She ___ her notes every night after class." (habit)
questions.hint: "every night" = regular habit → Present Simple: she reviews.
"right now" = Present Continuous: she is reviewing.

questions.text: Which sentence has a stative verb used INCORRECTLY?
questions.hint: "want" is stative → always Present Simple: "I want a coffee." ✅ Never "I'm wanting."

questions.text: "Technology ___ very fast these days." Choose the correct form.
questions.hint: "these days" + ongoing trend → PC. Technology is currently changing/developing.

questions.text: Amir ___ (usually / fix) bugs alone, but today Rustam ___ (help).
"What ___ you ___ for a living?" vs "What ___ you ___ right now?"
questions.hint: "for a living" = in general = PS: "What do you do?" / "right now" = current action = PC: "What are you doing?"

questions.text: "I think English is important." — why is this Present Simple?
opts: Because it happened in the past
Because it's a fact about nature
questions.hint: "think" = opinion → stative → always PS. "I think = I believe." But "I'm thinking about it" = I'm considering = PC ✅.

questions.text: "She is working from home today" suggests this is a temporary arrangement.
questions.hint: PC for temporary situations: "is working today" implies she doesn't normally work from home. It's just for today.

questions.text: Choose the sentence where BOTH tenses are used correctly.
opts: She studies now and works every day.
She is studying now and works every day.
She is studying now and is working every day.
She studies now and is working every day.
questions.correct: She is studying now and works every day.
questions.hint: "now" → PC: is studying. "every day" → PS: works. Both must match their signal words.

questions.text: "Shhh! The baby ___!" (sleep) — Complete with the correct tense.
questions.hint: "Shhh!" = be quiet because of something happening RIGHT NOW → PC: "The baby is sleeping!"

questions.text: "Does he study every day?" is a ___ question.
questions.hint: "Does he...?" = Present Simple question. (Present Continuous = "Is he studying right now?")

questions.text: "My English ___ this semester — I can feel it!" Choose the right form.
questions.hint: Ongoing change/trend → PC: "My English is improving." (getting better over a period = changing situation).
